versions.statuteQuote: Unless impractical to do so, the landlord shall give the tenant at least 72 hours' notice of routine maintenance to be performed that has not been requested by the tenant.

summaryForModel: Unless impractical, the landlord must give at least 72 hours' notice before routine maintenance the tenant did not request. A lease that states a shorter notice period conflicts with this.
paraphraseExamples: Landlord may enter for routine maintenance upon 24 hours' notice.
Management will provide 12 hours' notice before scheduled maintenance visits.
tenantExplanation: For routine maintenance you didn't ask for, Virginia requires your landlord to give you at least 72 hours' notice.
action: You can ask your landlord to change the notice period for routine maintenance to at least 72 hours.
